verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists a Screenshots feature that captures page screenshots during crawling for debugging or analysis, so basic page capture is supported. Nothing confirms full-page screenshots specifically: the Full-Page Scanning feature is about scrolling to load dynamic content, not imaging. There is also no evidence of capturing a selected element or region. Missing for 10: explicit full-page screenshot documentation, element/region-specific screenshot capture, API/parameter docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
